newsitem.title: DUBAI: Fujairah bunker markets revist year highs.
newsitem.headline: Fujairah bunker markets revist year highs.

text.p: Fujairah 380-cst bunker grades revisted year highs of $116-117 a tonne on Monday, led higher by firmer cargo markets and a pick up in Gulf shipping fuel demand, bunker market sources said on Monday.
"There is good demand...Shippers took advantage of the lower prices when they could," said a trader.
Fujairah 380-cst fuel slid to $109 a tonne last week, tracking weaker Singapore markets.
The port in the Gulf of Oman is the third largest bunkering centre behind Singapore and Rotterdam, moving some 214,000 barrels per day (bpd) of fuel.
